# Flipper-IRDB files

Infrared code files from the Flipper-IRDB project (https://github.com/Lucaslhm/Flipper-IRDB),
licensed CC0-1.0. They are unmodified copies: each was added once and never changed in this
repository. Contributor credit lines inside the files are kept as they came.

They are inputs for `tools/flipper2device.py`, which runs on a computer and turns them into the
card files in `devices/`. They are not installed on the CardputerZero.

| File | Upstream path |
|---|---|
| `Apple_TV_4K_Gen2.ir` | `Streaming_Devices/Apple/Apple_TV_4K_Gen2.ir` |
| `Apple_TV.ir` | not recorded (no spec uses this file) |
| `Dyson_HP02.ir` | `Fans/Dyson/Dyson_HP02.ir` |
| `Hisense_65K3300UW.ir` | `TVs/Hisense/Hisense_65K3300UW.ir` |
| `Samsung_BN59-01315B.ir` | `TVs/Samsung/Samsung_BN59-01315B.ir` |

The upstream paths are the ones recorded in the `source` strings of the specs in `devices/src/`.
The upstream revision the files were copied from is not recorded.
